description: A plugin that is installed on this site. The editor runs it with the permissions of the user who uses the editor.

fields.description: The unique name of the plugin, in the form "publisher/name".
fields.label: Plugin

fields.description: Where the plugin files come from: a Builder Hub, a Frappe app or a development server.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The URL of the Builder Hub that supplied the files. The Plugins panel shows it. Builder does not use it to identify the plugin.
fields.label: Hub URL

fields.description: When this is off, the plugin does not run for any user.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: A short summary. The Plugins panel shows it below the label.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The name of an SVG file in the root folder of the package, such as icon.svg. The editor shows this icon next to the plugin.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: The README of the plugin, in Markdown. The Builder Hub supplies it. For a development server, Builder reads it from the plugin folder of the author.
fields.label: Readme

fields.description: The version of the plugin that this site uses.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: A hash of the installed package. Builder uses it as the name of the release folder, so each release has different file URLs.
fields.label: Checksum

fields.description: The status of a Hub install. It is Installing while a background job downloads the package. Then it changes to Ready or Failed.
fields.label: Install State

fields.description: The reason that the last Hub install failed. The Plugins panel shows it with a Retry button.
fields.label: Install Error

name: Builder Plugin
